_about: Known-good extension publishers. A match adds trust to an extension's risk score.
Chrome/Brave/Vivaldi/Opera/Chromium: trusted ONLY by chrome_publisher_ids (the immutable
Chrome Web Store publisher ID, 'u' + 32 hex, from the publisher link on the listing page).
Display names are never trusted for Chrome-family stores: anyone can register a lookalike name.
Firefox/Edge/Safari: match_names are compared after normalization (case, punctuation, and
legal suffixes like Inc/LLC/Ltd/GmbH are ignored).
Every entry needs name and added_at (ISO 8601 UTC). Invalid entries are skipped with a warning.
Edits apply on the next extension scoring cycle; no rebuild or restart needed.
